Module advanceWars

Package co.edu.unbosque.view

package co.edu.unbosque.view
This package contains the classes responsible for the graphical user interface (GUI) of the "ADVANCE-WARS" game. These classes manage the windows, panels, and other graphical components used in the game, enabling user interaction, animation display, and the representation of various game elements on the screen. Classes included in this package: - ViewFacade: Represents the view facade in the application, using the Singleton pattern. - VentanaOpciones: Window that represents the options for the "ADVANCE-WARS" game. - PanelPeleas: Panel for displaying fight animations between different units. - PanelRio: Graphical panel that shows an image of a river, with the option to include a pointer. - RoundedTextField: A text field with rounded borders. - VentanaPrincipal: The main window of the "ADVANCE-WARS" game, responsible for managing the user interface panels and graphic elements. - PanelPausa: Pause panel containing options to resume, save, or exit the game. - PanelMontanaGrande: Panel that shows an image of a large mountain. - PanelOpciones: Panel to manage game options. - PanelPartidas: Panel to display ongoing game matches. - PanelJugadores2: Panel to manage the interface for a two-player game. - PanelJugadores3: Panel to manage the interface for a three-player game. - PanelJugadores4: Panel to manage the interface for a four-player game. - PanelMapa: Graphical panel for displaying a map within the game interface. - PanelMontana: Panel that shows an image of mountains. - PanelCampo: Panel that shows a field, with the option to include a pointer and a character. - PanelCasa: Panel that shows a house with the option to include a pointer. - PanelEdificio: Panel that shows a building with the option to include a pointer. - PanelGameOver: Panel that appears when the game is over (Game Over). - PanelJugadores: Panel to manage players, allowing name input and option selection using buttons. - PanelAccion: Action panel that contains buttons for available game actions. - PanelApartamento: Panel that shows an apartment with the option to include a pointer. - PanelArbol: Panel that shows a tree with the option to include a pointer. - PanelBienvenida: Welcome panel of the game, with buttons to start the game, exit, or view matches. - PanelCamino: Panel that shows a path with the option to include a pointer. - CenteredRoundedTextField: A text field with rounded borders and centered text. - MensajeEmergente: Class that provides methods to display pop-up messages using JOptionPane.
